sunoData.title: Lantern Room
sunoData.tags: Ambient game music with slow 72 BPM pulse, soft felt piano and warm string pads carrying gentle suspended chords; verse-like passages stay sparse for close dialogue, then a subtle pre-chorus lift brings glassy harmonics and brushed percussion into reunion moments, before the main cue opens into tender sustained layers for emotional focus. Breath-like swells, reverse piano tails, and delicate bell echoes bridge scenes. Intimate, polished, wide cinematic mix with close detail and glowing room warmth., romantic, soft, ambient, emotional
